correctness.rationale: A direct independent restricted-growth enumeration of all squarefree q-letter words for q<=5, and an independent C++ exhaustive 6-letter implementation evaluating square creation after every letter insertion, confirmed b(q)=(2,4,6,10,14), thresholds 1/2/1/2/1 canonical blocked words, q5 6936 terminal words, q6 6,480,694 terminal words and witness 01020103435343. Incremental suffix square test plus canonical first-occurrence coding exhaust all words; the two-sided Zimin palindrome and disjoint-alphabet junction prove general upper bound. Count claims restricted to q<=6.
residual_risks: An unpublished or unindexed larger exhaustive census may contain q5/q6 minima.
